decisions.reason: The rendered footnote (cite_note-GaiaEDR3) carries '(Erratum: doi:10.1051/0004-6361/202039657e)', generated by the Cite Gaia EDR3 template for the cited Gaia EDR3 paper. It states no retraction and no expression of concern, so 'warning' does not apply. The locked 'none' asserts that no retraction or correction vocabulary is present in the rendered footnote; that is not so. Section 3.6 names 'erratum' as ambiguous vocabulary and defines 'none' as absence of these, so 'ambiguous' is the closest reading of the guide. Judgment call: the erratum relation is to the cited work itself and could be read as settled, which would give 'none'. Flagged for the owner's review.

u13, <ref name=Borisov2023/> at cp 2175 is the temperature parameter. The rendered 'Temperature' row (9494±143 K) shows marker cite_ref-Borisov2023_11-1. Locked id is right. The engine's source-order mapping (-0) is wrong. The guide says Parsoid places markers in source order, but Starbox expands its parameters out of source order (the 'Surface gravity' row is -0 although gravity follows temperature in the source). The marker displayed beside a value is that parameter's marker, so the row label decides. Flagged as a reading of the guide.
